title: pentameris alticola
intro: Pentameris alticola, commonly known as a type of grass, is a plant species within the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems, thereby offering several health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pentameris alticola include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help in reducing fever, alleviating pain, and facilitating the removal of mucus from the respiratory tract, respectively. Bioactive constituents present in Pentameris alticola include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
